tasks.corrected_reference_answer: The cited code does not establish a high-concurrency cleanup failure. DockerClient.close delegates to its API session (docker/client.py:210-212); custom adapters are mounted on that session (docker/api/client.py:143-190). BaseHTTPAdapter.close calls its parent close and clears its pools (docker/transport/basehttpadapter.py:4-8), and Unix pools explicitly configure disposal with p.close (unixconn.py:71-73). CancellableStream.close shuts down its own underlying socket and explicitly rejects Paramiko SSH channels (docker/types/daemon.py:40-74). A leak or cross-stream race would require reproducing and measuring a specific failure, not inferring it from absence of async context management.
